name: Pocket Casts
why_listed: Cross-platform podcast listeners who want bookmarks and timestamp sharing inside a mainstream player would use Pocket Casts instead of Spoken Margins.

platforms.value: iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, Android, web, macOS, Windows (plus Apple TV, CarPlay)
platforms.detail: Mobile apps on iOS/Android, a web player, and Mac and Windows desktop apps.

sources.title: Pocket Casts’ Web Player Is Now Available to All – Pocket Casts Blog
sources.quote: These changes also apply to our Mac and Windows Desktop Apps, giving you more ways to listen on your terms.

sources.title: Episode Transcripts – Pocket Casts Support
sources.quote: All Pocket Casts users on Android and iOS can access transcripts directly within the app

sources.title: Pocket Casts: Podcast Player - App Store (US)
sources.quote: Everywhere: CarPlay, AirPlay, Chromecast and Sonos.

platforms.note: App Store listing (via WebFetch summary) lists iPhone, iPad, Apple TV and Apple Watch.

price_free_tier.value: Free podcast player on mobile, web and desktop; bookmarks, generated transcripts and synced transcript highlighting need Plus.
price_free_tier.detail: Core listening is free; web and desktop no longer need a subscription.

sources.quote: the Pocket Casts Web Player is now accessible to all, no subscription required

sources.quote: As of May 2025 Pocket Casts Plus and Patron subscribers can also see automatically generated transcripts for select podcasts.

price_paid.detail: Plus is the cheapest paid plan.

sources.quote: If you see a price higher than USD 39.99, our payment processors are likely charging you taxes and fees based on your location.

price_paid.note: Support page (US dollars, base rates; last updated 2024-05-10) and US App Store in-app purchase list. pocketcasts.com/plans returned 403.

plays_podcasts.detail: Full podcast player that subscribes to and streams/downloads feeds.

sources.title: Pocket Casts’ Web Player Is Now Available to All – Pocket Casts Blog
sources.quote: Starting today, anyone can stream any podcast episode directly from our Web Player, no account or subscription needed.

reads_web_articles_aloud.note: Checked App Store listing; pocketcasts.com/plus returned 403. No mention of reading articles aloud, but no comprehensive feature list was readable.

Pocket Casts Plus

reads_pdfs_aloud.note: Checked App Store listing; pocketcasts.com/plus returned 403. No mention of PDFs.

voice_notes_anchored.detail: Bookmarks save a timestamp (with optional title); there is no note-taking, spoken or typed, on bookmarks.

sources.title: Bookmarks, notes, and sharing | Pocket Casts Forum
sources.quote: We log every feature requests made here, including the note-taking and exporting features. We don't have immediate plans to implement them at the moment

sources.title: Bookmarks on the iOS and Android Mobile Apps – Pocket Casts Support

voice_notes_anchored.note: Based on a staff reply in the official forum (2025-05-23) and the bookmarks help page, which mentions no voice notes.

text_notes_anchored.detail: A bookmark at a timestamp can carry an optional typed title; Smart Bookmarks (iOS, Plus) auto-fill a title and transcript passage. No free-form note field.

sources.title: Bookmarks on the iOS and Android Mobile Apps – Pocket Casts Support
sources.quote: You will be prompted to enter an optional title to identify the bookmark you're adding.

sources.title: Smart Bookmarks: save the words, not the timestamp – Pocket Casts Blog
sources.quote: A title, written for you. The passage from the transcript, captured around the moment you tapped.

sources.title: Bookmarks, notes, and sharing | Pocket Casts Forum
sources.quote: We log every feature requests made here, including the note-taking and exporting features.

text_notes_anchored.note: Bookmarks require Plus or Patron per the 2023 launch post.

hands_free_capture.detail: Headphone previous/next actions can be set to Add Bookmark, with a confirmation sound.

sources.title: Bookmarks, no longer just for books! – Pocket Casts Blog
sources.quote: you can also add them straight from your headphones using our highly customizable Headphone Action settings

sources.title: Bookmarks on the iOS and Android Mobile Apps – Pocket Casts Support

hands_free_capture.note: Plus/Patron feature. Apple Watch and CarPlay bookmark capture not confirmed in pages read.

transcripts.detail: Creator transcripts for everyone; auto-generated transcripts for select shows and synced highlighting on Plus/Patron.

sources.title: Episode Transcripts – Pocket Casts Support
sources.quote: All Pocket Casts users on Android and iOS can access transcripts directly within the app

sources.title: Read along as you listen: Highlighted Transcripts are here! – Pocket Casts Blog
sources.quote: Pocket Casts generated transcripts are available for Plus and Patron users.

transcripts.note: Generated transcripts only for select popular shows and episodes under 2 hours.

ai_summaries.detail: AI-generated chapters were launched in July 2026 but the support site says they are temporarily turned off; no AI episode summaries found.

sources.title: Chapters – Pocket Casts Support
sources.quote: AI-generated chapters are temporarily unavailable.

sources.title: AI Generated Chapters Are Here – Pocket Casts Blog
sources.quote: Pocket Casts now supports AI generated Chapters on Android, Web, Desktop and (coming very soon…) iOS.

export_markdown_pkm.detail: No export of bookmarks to note apps; staff say it is a logged request with no immediate plans.

sources.title: Bookmarks, notes, and sharing | Pocket Casts Forum
sources.quote: We log every feature requests made here, including the note-taking and exporting features. We don't have immediate plans to implement them at the moment

export_markdown_pkm.note: Staff forum reply dated 2025-05-23; not re-confirmed against a newer changelog.

share_note_at_moment.detail: Sharing a bookmark gives a link that opens the episode at the bookmark's timestamp; no note content travels with it.

sources.title: Bookmarks on the iOS and Android Mobile Apps – Pocket Casts Support
sources.quote: Sharing a bookmark gives you a link to the episode that opens at the bookmark's timestamp

share_note_at_moment.note: Bookmarks on private podcasts or uploaded files cannot be shared (per help page summary).

group_listening.detail: No group, club or shared-annotation feature found.

group_listening.note: Checked App Store listing and blog posts; /plus page returned 403. Nothing found either way.

on_device_privacy.detail: The web player works with no account; the app syncs subscriptions, history and bookmarks to Pocket Casts' cloud when signed in.

sources.title: Pocket Casts’ Web Player Is Now Available to All – Pocket Casts Blog
sources.quote: Starting today, anyone can stream any podcast episode directly from our Web Player, no account or subscription needed.

sources.title: Pocket Casts: Podcast Player - App Store (US)
sources.quote: Subscriptions, Up Next, listening history, playback and filters are all securely stored in the cloud.

on_device_privacy.note: No on-device processing claim; generated transcripts are made on Pocket Casts' servers per press coverage.

account_required.detail: Listening needs no account; a free account adds cross-device sync, and Plus features need a subscription.

sources.title: Pocket Casts’ Web Player Is Now Available to All – Pocket Casts Blog
sources.quote: Starting today, anyone can stream any podcast episode directly from our Web Player, no account or subscription needed.

account_required.note: The source is explicit for the web player; mobile use without an account is described in third-party coverage, not a vendor page read here.
